scripts.build:android-web: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item dist -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path dist | Out-Null; Copy-Item index.html,manifest.json,service-worker.js -Destination dist -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item assets,vendor,icons -Destination dist -Recurse -Force; npx cap sync android"
